newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Bodies of air crash victims arrive in Addis Ababa.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of air crash victims arrive in Addis Ababa.

text.p: The bodies of 35 people who perished in a hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane which crashed into the Indian ocean two weeks ago arrived in the Ethiopian capital on Wednesday.
On hand to receive the bodies was Ethiopian President Negasso Gidada, cabinet ministers and relatives.

The Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 767 was hijacked on November 23 as it flew from Addis Ababa to Nairobi. The plane ran out of fuel and crashed into the sea off the Comoros, an archipelago 300 kms (190 miles) east of the African mainland.
Fifty of 175 passengers and crew survived. The other 125 died. They included award-winning cameraman Mohamed Amin.
Officials said funeral ceremonies for the crash victims will be held at different cemeteries in Addis Ababa later on Wednesday.
